REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - JULY 28, 2022 - 07:00 P.M.
CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER
18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA 90703
* COVID-19 NOTICE *
To protect public health and safety during the COVID-19 pandemic and in compliance with the current State Department of Public Health and Los Angeles County Health Officer Orders and City of Cerritos COVID-19 Safety Plan, the City Council Chamber will be open to the public. As authorized by State of California Executive Orders N-25-20, N-29-20, and N-08-21, and subsequently by Assembly Bill 361 (Chapter 165, Statutes of 2021) and City Council Resolution No. 2022-10 adopted pursuant thereto, this meeting may also be conducted via teleconference, if necessary. Public observation and participation in this meeting will be facilitated through the methods described below.
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at www.cerritos.us and at the Office of the City Clerk, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 1st floor, Cerritos, CA, during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the legislative body after distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection in the Office of the City Clerk during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to city_clerk@cerritos.us or by phone at (562) 916-1248 during regular business hours.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at www.cerritos.us, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or in-person in the Council Chamber subject to posted COVID-19 protocols.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in-person at the meeting or by using the following alternate methods:
Written correspondence (hard copy or email): Public comments can be submitted via email to city_clerk@cerritos.us or by hard copy to the Office the City Clerk no later than 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 3:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the legislative body prior to the meeting. During the meeting, your name and summary comments will be read into the record. The document will be retained with the public record of the meeting.
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 916-1248 to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the meeting.

11B.
City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Meeting Reports
During this part of the meeting members of the City Council report to the community on various matters of interest, including reports concerning committees on which the Councilmembers serve and reports on meetings/conferences attended. In addition, requests may be made of the staff for reports which will be presented to the City Council at a subsequent meeting, or for the scheduling of future agenda items. There will be no discussion or action taken on any of the items that may be presented during this agenda item.

MINUTES OF A REGULAR MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AND THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY HELD THURSDAY,
JULY 28, 2022, 7:00 P.M., IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBER AT CERRITOS CITY HALL, 18125
BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA.

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Invocation

  The invocation was given by Vida Barone, City Clerk/Treasurer.

3.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Mayor Chuong Vo.

4.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Lynda P. Johnson
  Council/Agency Member Naresh Solanki
  Council/Agency Member Frank A. Yokoyama
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Bruce Barrows
  Mayor/Chair Chuong Vo

5.  Presentations/Appointments

5A.  Presentations

  Mayor Vo announced the meeting would adjourn in memory of Beverle Ray, long-time
  Cerritos resident and wife of former Mayor and Councilmember George Ray.

  A proclamation was made by the City Council as follows:

  Goody’s Donuts (Business Spotlight).

5B.  Review and consideration of the 2022-2024 City Council appointments to the Cerritos
  Advisory Boards (Commissions and Committees) (COUNCIL).

  The Mayor opened the public comments period. Noting there were no individuals who
  elected to provide public comment, the Mayor declared the public comments period
  closed.

  MOTION: It was moved by Vo, and seconded by Barrows, to approve Mayor Vo’s
  nomination, as listed below, for a two-year term of service, commencing July 28, 2022
  and expiring April 30, 2024 (COUNCIL):

  Name  Advisory Board
  Sandra Gonzalez  Parks and Recreation Commission

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Johnson, Solanki, Yokoyama, Barrows, Vo
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None
 City of Cerritos  Thursday, July 28, 2022, 7:00 p.m.
City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting  Page 2 of 5

5.  Presentations/Appointments (continued)

5C.  Informational update on the City’s response to the COVID-19 pandemic and other City
  events, services, and programs.

  An informational update was given by Annie Hylton, City Librarian & Marketing Manager. A
  PowerPoint presentation was displayed.

  There was no action taken on this item.

6.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  The Mayor opened the public comments period.

  Written Correspondence:
  (Written correspondence is considered public record. Full-text copies of submitted
  written correspondence can be obtained in the Office of the City Clerk/Treasurer)

  Matthew Ellis submitted written correspondence expressing appreciation to the City and
  contractor Harry Dantema, for improvements made to lighting fixtures at Heritage Park
  and the Cerritos Sculpture Garden.

  In-Person Public Comments:

  Payal Sawhney announced an upcoming program for the benefit of small business
  owners and entrepreneurs which provides them with professional guidance.

  Noting there were no other individuals who elected to provide public comment, the
  Mayor declared the public comments period closed.

7.  Consent Calendar

7A.  Approval of Minutes

  Thursday, July 14, 2022, 7:00 p.m. City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting
  Minutes (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Solanki, to approve the Thursday,
  July 14, 2022, 7:00 p.m. City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Johnson, Solanki, Yokoyama, Barrows, Vo
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

(minutes continue on the next page)
 City of Cerritos  Thursday, July 28, 2022, 7:00 p.m.
City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting  Page 3 of 5

7.  Consent Calendar (continued)

7B.  Approval of the Register of Demands

7B.1. Register of Demands for the City of Cerritos dated July 28, 2022 (COUNCIL).

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Solanki, to approve the Register of
  Demands as follows:

  City of Cerritos  July 28, 2022  $ 7,230,587.96 (COUNCIL)

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Johnson, Solanki, Yokoyama, Barrows, Vo
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

7C.  Approval of Treasurer's Reports

  City Council/Successor Agency Treasurer's Reports for the period ending June 30,
  2022 (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Solanki, to approve the City
  Council/Successor Agency Treasurer’s Reports for the period ending June 30, 2022
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Johnson, Solanki, Yokoyama, Barrows, Vo
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

7D.  Waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, AUTHORIZING AND IMPLEMENTING TELECONFERENCE
  ACCESSIBILITY FOR CONDUCTING PUBLIC MEETINGS PURSUANT TO ASSEMBLY BILL
  361 (STATS. 2021, CH. 165) (COUNCIL).

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Solanki, to waive full reading of and
  adopt Resolution No. 2022-32, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE
  CITY OF CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, AUTHORIZING AND IMPLEMENTING
  TELECONFERENCE ACCESSIBILITY FOR CONDUCTING PUBLIC MEETINGS
  PURSUANT TO ASSEMBLY BILL 361 (STATS. 2021, CH. 165) (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Johnson, Solanki, Yokoyama, Barrows, Vo
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

8.  Public Hearings

  None.
 City of Cerritos  Thursday, July 28, 2022, 7:00 p.m.
City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting  Page 4 of 5

9.  New and Old Business

9A.  Review and consideration of an informational budget and audit compliance report for
  Fiscal Year 2021-22 (COUNCIL).

  A staff reports was given by Jeff Thielke, Budget Manager. A PowerPoint presentation
  was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period. Noting there were no individuals who
  elected to provide public comment, the Mayor declared the public comments period
  closed.

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Johnson, to ratify the executed
  Budget Amendments from the Fourth Quarter of Fiscal Year 2021-2022 as summarized
  in the Budget Adjustment Log presented in the associated agenda report (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Johnson, Solanki, Yokoyama, Barrows, Vo
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

9B.  Review and consideration of impacts to the City’s future general municipal elections due
  to legislative changes in the dates established for municipal elections by State law
  (Senate Bill 970) (COUNCIL).

  Staff reports were given by Vida Barone, City Clerk/Treasurer and Bill Ihrke, City
  Attorney. A PowerPoint presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period. Noting there were no individuals who
  elected to provide public comment, the Mayor declared the public comments period
  closed.

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Solanki, to direct staff to schedule,
  no earlier than the second regular City Council meeting in March 2023, the publicly
  noticed review and consideration of introduction, and subsequent publicly noticed
  adoption, of an ordinance to establish the City’s general municipal election date as the
  first Tuesday after the first Monday in March of odd-numbered years and conduct the
  City’s next general municipal election on Tuesday, March 4, 2025 (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (3 – 2) as follows:

  AYES:  Solanki, Barrows, Vo
  NOES:  Johnson, Yokoyama
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

10.  Legislative Items

10A.  Report on pending legislation.

  None.

10B.  Review and consideration to support or oppose specific legislation in the State or Federal
  legislature or in the State or Federal Executive Office for signature.

  None.
 City of Cerritos  Thursday, July 28, 2022, 7:00 p.m.
City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting  Page 5 of 5

11.  Reports

11A.  Report from City Manager/Executive Director

  None.

11B.  City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Meeting Reports

  Reports were given by Councilmember Johnson, Mayor Pro Tem Barrows, and Mayor Vo.

  CONSENSUS (Vo): Directed the City Manager to plan and conduct a community safety
  seminar and extend invitations to local agencies to participate in hosting the event,
  including Cerritos Sheriff’s Station and ABC Unified School District.

  CONSENSUS (Solanki): Directed the City Manager to provide the City Council with the
  regular informational report regarding the status of development projects.

12.  Closed Session

  Bill Ihrke, City Attorney, announced the City Council would recess to Closed Session to
  discuss Items 12A and 12B, as listed on the Closed Session agenda:

  12A.  CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL - ANTICIPATED LITIGATION
  Consider initiation of litigation
  Pursuant to Government Code 54956.9(d)(4) (COUNCIL)
  Number of cases: One (1)

  12B.  CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL - ANTICIPATED LITIGATION
  Consider initiation of litigation
  Pursuant to Government Code 54956.9(d)(4) (COUNCIL)
  Number of cases: One (1)

  CLOSED SESSION REPORT:

  Bill Ihrke, City Attorney, reported the City Council convened into Closed Session to
  discuss Items 12A and 12B, as listed on the Closed Session agenda. The City Council
  received briefings on the aforementioned Items and no reportable action was taken.
  There was nothing further to report.

13.  Adjournment

  The meeting adjourned at 9:50 p.m. in memory of Beverle Ray, long-time Cerritos
  resident and wife of former Mayor and Councilmember George Ray.

  /s/Vida Barone
  Vida Barone, City Clerk/Agency Secretary
